summary: Describes a mechanism that uses opportunistic TLS to encrypt Remote Procedure Call transactions in transit. It interoperates with ONC RPC implementations that do not support it, and it updates RFC 5531. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Computers ask each other to run tasks, and those requests used to travel in plain sight. This makes them go inside a sealed envelope by default, while still working with old machines.

questions: how to encrypt onc rpc traffic
